problem_context.problem_statement: Reverify CircularAreaGetMaxLength using the unique shared CircularAreaLogicalState and mixed buffer ownership. The non-null query must be legal at every callpoint that owns a valid unified state, return the exact capacity, and preserve the entire state. The null branch must return the real C ERROR=1.
problem_context.expected_behavior: For a non-null valid unified state return area_length; for null return ERROR=1. Preserve descriptor identity and all fields, logical FIFO, physical option-byte list, GlobalStrings and UCharArray::mixed_full. Do not read or convert backing cells.
problem_context.input_output_contract: Use CircularAreaLogicalState/CircularAreaBackingResource from the common QCIPLib as the only non-null representation before and after. Canonical p_head and p_tail come from the shared resource. Return identical existential state values.
spec_hint: Keep only the pure result relation local. Remove CircularAreaDescriptorState and UCharArray::full from the callable contract. The query projects area_length and has no buffer effect.
preferred_hidden_properties: read-only callpoint composability after Init/Write/Read/Reset and before any unified-state consumer

hidden_properties: read-only callpoint composability for every valid unified state
descriptor identity and every existential state value are preserved
canonical p_head and p_tail are inherited from the shared resource
UCharArray::mixed_full option-byte ownership is preserved without a backing-cell read
